title: Proposal: OmniTray - drag, drop, stack, and shelf anything
author: jiripolasek

status.label: Maintainer-owned product proposal

next_action.label: Keep product evaluation upstream

judgment.rationale: OmniTray is already an assigned maintainer proposal with prototype evidence and open product questions, so parallel dashboard design would be duplicative.
evidence: The issue is labeled Idea-New PowerToy.
The collaborator author is also the assignee.
The body includes a prototype and detailed alternatives for stacks, shelves, commands, integrations, and extension architecture.
judgment.recommended_action: Leave scope selection and product validation in the assigned upstream proposal; split implementation trackers only after maintainers choose an MVP.

issue_context.summary: OmniTray proposes a new PowerToy for persistent stacks and drop commands exposed through edge shelves and floating trays.
known_information: The issue contains an external prototype, screenshots, a video, and a detailed product pitch.
The proposed MVP starts with clipboard-to-stack while the broader scope includes drag surfaces, shell integrations, and out-of-process extensions.
The proposal is assigned to its collaborator author.
inferences: The implementation should be decomposed only after maintainers select an MVP and decide whether it belongs in PowerToys.
Attempting a complete implementation design now would prematurely resolve open product questions documented by the author.
issue_context.analysis: This is active product ownership, not an unattended bug or bounded enhancement. The previous scope-note action was a no-op status comment and is removed rather than exposed as a maintainer action.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete long-form pitch, prototype link, comments, labels, assignment, and timeline.
Confirmed there is no linked upstream implementation PR requiring separate dashboard work.

information_gaps.information: Maintainer-selected MVP, hosting model, and extension boundary
information_gaps.why_needed: These decisions define whether and how implementation trackers should be created.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve through the assigned upstream product discussion and prototype evaluation.
